record.title: Preserve independent reads of exposed eMMC user area
record.intent: Acquire the observed block device as immutable raw evidence distinct from logical files.
requirements: Proceed only after verified root and read access. Recheck the observed mmcblk0 size of 31299993600 bytes against sysfs and blockdev; confirm destination capacity.

Under isolated maintained lease and full capture stream one complete read directly to a fresh host file, hash it and make the completed artifact read-only. Never overwrite a previous image or conceal a short read.

Attempt a second independent read into a separate file with its own hash if the first is complete and conditions remain healthy. Preserve differences; mounted writable filesystems mean identical hashes and point-in-time consistency are not guaranteed.

No writes to source devices, reboot, remount, freeze, firmware change, physical entitlement or host security-policy change. Stop on loss of isolation, capture failure, source read error or insufficient storage.
Preserve command/error output, timestamps, exact counts and hashes, graceful capture/drop statistics and host restoration. Describe the exposed user area, not unobserved eMMC boot/RPMB storage.
acceptance: Complete separately hashed raw reads or a bounded acquisition failure are preserved without changing source storage.
